description: Use this when the user asks what has been found about a relation: does an intervention extend lifespan, and in which organisms; what lowers a biomarker; what acts on a process. Lists findings extracted from papers as subject, relation and object (for example rapamycin extends_lifespan in Mus musculus), with organism, conditions, effect size and the paper, newest first. Narrow by subject, object, relation, organism or paper. Check a finding that matters against its paper with get_paper. Not for personal medical advice.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page. Keep the other parameters the same.

object.description: Object text, entity name or entity key (case-insensitive substring).

organism.description: Organism, e.g. Homo sapiens, Mus musculus (case-insensitive substring).

relation.description: Exact relation, e.g. increases, decreases, associated_with, extends_lifespan.

subject.description: Subject text, entity name or entity key (case-insensitive substring).

name: list_claims
